# Code Of Conduct

Sakuro is meant to be a focused, respectful open-source space. This code of conduct applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews, and any project-maintained community channels.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and patient.
- Assume good intent, but accept corrections.
- Keep feedback specific and actionable.
- Make room for beginners and non-native English speakers.
- Discuss tradeoffs without turning technical disagreement into personal criticism.
- Credit other people's work, research, and assets.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, threats, insults, or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory language or behavior.
- Sexualized comments or imagery in project spaces.
- Doxxing or sharing private information without permission.
- Repeated off-topic posting after being asked to stop.
- Bad-faith reports, review disruption, or deliberate misinformation.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove comments, close issues, reject pull requests, or restrict participation when behavior harms the project or its contributors.

If you experience or observe unacceptable behavior, contact a maintainer privately through the repository's listed support channel. Include links, screenshots, or context when possible.

Reports will be handled with care. Retaliation against someone who reports a concern is not acceptable.
